expressions.en: Can you help me? / Could you give me a hand?
expressions.cn: 你可以帮我吗？/ 你能帮我一下吗？
expressions.bm_formal: Bolehkah anda membantu saya? / Mohon bantuan anda.

expressions.en: Could you repeat that? / Can you explain it again?
expressions.cn: 你能重复一遍吗？/ 你能再解释一次吗？
expressions.bm_formal: Bolehkah anda mengulanginya? / Boleh jelaskan semula?
expressions.bm_casual: Boleh ulang tak? / Ulang balik. / Cakap balik.

expressions.en: May I? / Is it okay if I?
expressions.cn: 我可以吗？/ 我这样做可以吗？
expressions.bm_casual: Boleh saya? / Okay tak kalau saya?

work.scenario: During a team meeting, you need clarification on a project deadline and want to offer help to a colleague who seems overwhelmed.
key_phrases: Bolehkah anda jelaskan semula tarikh akhir projek?
Saya faham, jadi kita perlu selesaikan ini menjelang Jumaat.
Boleh saya bantu anda dengan laporan itu?

life.scenario: You're at a local market, accidentally bump into someone, and then ask a vendor if you can try a sample of fruit.

tech.scenario: Your computer isn't connecting to the internet, and you need to ask a technician for help. You also want to confirm their instructions.
key_phrases: Saya faham, jadi saya perlu 'restart' modem.
Mohon maaf, boleh ulang apa yang perlu saya buat?
